query: TotalEnergies offshore wind lease termination Trump 2026 return money Texas natural gas
answer: In 2026, the Trump administration paid TotalEnergies $928 million to terminate offshore wind projects, with the funds to be reinvested in U.S. oil and gas projects. This included investments in Texas natural gas infrastructure. The agreement aimed to halt offshore wind development in favor of fossil fuel projects.
